newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria's local building firms post mixed results.
newsitem.headline: Algeria's local building firms post mixed results.

text.p: Algeria's building materials company ETC, Entreprise de Travaux et de Construction, posted a profit of 23 million dinars ($410,714) in 1995, the official Algerian news agency said on Monday.
ETC, based in the eastern province of Tebessa, made the profit on a turnover of 270.7 million dinars ($4.8 million).
In the southern province of Biskra, building materials distributor Edimco made a loss of 4.3 million dinars ($76,785) in 1995, APS said.
The loss came from a turnover of 131.4 million dinars ($2.3 million).
There were no comparative figures for the year earlier, and neither company has reported its results for 1996.
